sources.description: Facing a second and goal inside the five to start the second quarter, the Denver Broncos were looking to extend their lead over the Las Vegas Raiders. Maxx Crosby blew up their second down play that was going to be a wide open screen for a touchdown had he not been in Bo Nix’s face […]
